$comment: Files an executor host and fleet-update share on disk (docs/designs/fleet-self-update.md, section 4). Hosts run mixed versions during a self-update, so a file's shape changes only compatibly.

UpdateSignal.$comment: <data dir>/update/update.json: written by the executor from its poll answers (temp file, then rename, only when a value other than at changes), read by fleet-update

restartTarget.$comment: the target version the executor has drained for and may be restarted into; absent when none

target.$comment: the version the coordinator asks for; null when none

autoUpdate.$comment: on, off or an RFC 3339 UTC time until which updates are held

pollError.$comment: network or http-<status> of the last failed poll; absent when the poll succeeded

UpdateStateFile.$comment: <data dir>/update/update-state.json, written by fleet-update; the executor reads last and sends it in its poll. fleet-update keeps the same shape per part in pds18-state.json and in ui-state.json

Pds18StateFile.$comment: /var/lib/fleet-update/pds18-state.json, written by fleet-update on PDS18; the coordinator reads hostId and each part's last for that host's row

hostId.$comment: the PDS18 executor's host id, from its update.json
